items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: we hired a young man named Lester Nichols on the drums.

ctx.x: Lester Nichols, we hired a young man named Lester Nichols on the drums. I can't remember who we had on trombone or whether we had a trombone player or not. Can you remember, Charles?
Snub Mosely left the band to join orchestra. So, we rehearsed the band, the drummer left too. A. G. Godley left and we hired Spare Ribs, what was his name?
